basic_details.post_name: Asst Programmer 'B' 1-(C) ISGC, Asst Programmer 'B' 2-(C) ISGC, Sr. Programmer 1-(C) ISGC and 3 more
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology, Delhi (NIELIT), New Delhi, has invited applications for 6 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. 07/356/2026/NDL/FM. The posts include Asst Programmer 'B' 1-(C) ISGC, Asst Programmer 'B' 2-(C) ISGC, Sr. Programmer 1-(C) ISGC, Sr. Programmer 2-(C) ISGC and 2 more. The online application is open from 3 November 2026 to 17 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Net Banking/IMPS. Last date to pay the fee: 17 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Electronics, MCA or B.Sc (Computer Science Engg.)

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 33,756 to Rs. 1,03,745, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Submit the Google registration form from 03-11-2026 to 17-11-2026.
Deposit non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 750/- per position through Net Banking/IMPS.
Candidates interested in applying for different positions must submit separate applications and fees for each post.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any manner will disqualify the candidate. No TA/DA will be provided for interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 November 2026. Applications opened on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 Asst Programmer 'B' 1-(C) ISGC, 1 Asst Programmer 'B' 2-(C) ISGC, 1 Sr. Programmer 1-(C) ISGC, 1 Sr. Programmer 2-(C) ISGC, 1 Sr. System Analyst 1(C)- ISGC, 1 Sr. System Analyst 2(C)- ISGC.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 17 November 2026.

faq.answer: All Categories: Rs. 750 per position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 33756 for Asst Programmer 'B' 1-(C) ISGC, 33756 for Asst Programmer 'B' 2-(C) ISGC, 60519 for Sr. Programmer 1-(C) ISGC, 60519 for Sr. Programmer 2-(C) ISGC, 103745 for Sr. System Analyst 1(C)- ISGC.

faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Electronics, MCA or B.Sc (Computer Science Engg.). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. The qualification must be from a Govt. University or Govt. recognized University/Institutions. Name and Date of Birth must match with Aadhar Card.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document Verification. Interview / Interaction. Document verification and interview/interaction conducted at NIELIT Centre Janakpuri, Delhi for Delhi location.
